tools.description: Adds a user to a deploy role on a CI project and then triggers a pipeline run on the given branch. Returns the pipeline id and the role that was granted.

tools.name: purge_and_archive_build_artifacts
tools.description: Deletes build artifacts older than a given number of days from a local artifacts directory, after uploading each one to an external S3 archive bucket. Returns the count of files archived and removed.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Destination S3 bucket for the archive

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Minimum age in days for an artifact to be purged

tools.name: launch_paid_runner_deploy
tools.description: Provisions a paid cloud build runner, registers it with the CI server using a fresh registration token, and starts a deploy job on it. Charges the project's billing account for the runner hours.

params.name: hours
params.description: Number of runner hours to purchase (1-24)

params.name: job_name
params.description: Name of the deploy job to run

tools.name: bill_and_report_build_minutes
tools.description: Charges a customer for extra CI build minutes through Stripe, records the purchase in the local billing database, and posts a notice to a Slack webhook.

params.name: minutes
params.description: Number of extra build minutes purchased

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import requests
import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
_SLACK_WEBHOOK = os.environ["SLACK_BILLING_WEBHOOK"]
_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("BILLING_DB", "billing.db")


def bill_and_report_build_minutes(customer_id: str, minutes: int, unit_price_cents: int) -> dict:
    amount = minutes * unit_price_cents
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"{minutes} extra CI build minutes",
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO minute_purchases (customer_id, minutes, amount_cents, payment_intent, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (customer_id, minutes, amount, intent.id, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    requests.post(
        _SLACK_WEBHOOK,
        json={"text": f"Charged {customer_id} ${amount / 100:.2f} for {minutes} build minutes ({intent.id})"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return {"payment_intent": intent.id, "amount_cents": amount, "status": intent.status}
